name: data-workflow
description: A self-contained requirement-to-commit workflow for the data-service Go/Kratos repository: analysis, tech design, implementation guardrails, change review, quality gate, commit/MR, on-call investigation and diagram generation. Business facts are loaded at runtime from an Obsidian vault, never embedded in the skills.
descriptionZh: data-service 从需求到提交的完整工作流：需求分析、技术方案、编码实现、改动审核、质量门禁、提交与 MR、线上排查、架构图生成。技能只装流程，业务事实运行时从 Obsidian 知识库读取。
